AI Test Tools Make Bold Promises,
But Reality Hits Hard.

Before CoTester, We Ran Into the Same Problems You’re Facing

Promise

Truth

“You’ll be up and running instantly — just plug and play.”

Until it breaks at scale. Then you’re hand-holding it through every test.

“You’ll never have to maintain tests again.”

You’ll spend more time supervising flaky tests than running real ones.

“Our AI writes all your tests for you.”

Sure — until your app changes or you hit a dynamic UI element that needs an escape hatch.

“We execute the fastest tests in the industry.”

Some generate bloated test logic that slows everything down.

“Our tests self-heal automatically.”

Only if your definition of healing is “crash and forget.”

“Debugging is built-in!”

Visual flows and NLP output don’t help when you need real logs or root-cause clarity.

“We’re enterprise-ready from day one.”

If your enterprise has five engineers, no version control, and no need for speed.

“You can go no-code, low-code, or pro-code. It’s up to you.”

Complex logic still needs custom scripts, defeating the purpose.

“We’re built for seamless collaboration across teams.”

But with no Git support or visibility controls, it’s chaos in agile teams.

“CI/CD integration is seamless”

Until you try fitting it into your pipeline and hit a wall of workarounds.

“One tool to rule them all—everything you need in one place.”

One vendor to lock you in, which means proprietary logic, closed formats, and zero portability.

Book a Demo

From complex test scenarios to enterprise-scale challenges, and from version control to debugging, CoTester 2.0 brings unmatched speed, flexibility, reliability, and built-in test orchestration. It’s dependable, consistent, and always ready to test whenever you are.

CoTester2.0
Engineered for Intelligence. Powered by AI.
Context-Aware Agent

CoTester is a software testing AI agent that learns your product context and adapts to your QA workflows — then writes all your test code for you.

Book a Demo
Instant Test Creation

Upload or link your stories from JIRA. Our test case authoring agent turns your specs into full test logic within minutes. No time wasted.

Book a Demo
Self-Healing Capabilities

Our AI-powered auto-heal engine, AgentRx, automatically detects even major UI changes, including structural shifts and full redesigns, and updates your test logic on the fly during the test execution phase.

Book a Demo
Seamless Execution

Run tests across real browsers, get live feedback, and debug faster with the help of an AI agent for testing that never sleeps.

Book a Demo
AI Testing with Guardrails

CoTester pauses at critical checkpoints to validate its direction with your team, ensuring alignment, maintaining control, and making sure it never strays off course. All without slowing you down.

Book a Demo
Vision-Language
Intelligence

At the core of CoTester’s adaptability is a multi-modal Vision Language Model (VLM). It sees and interprets your app screen like a human tester, combining visuals, text, and layout to drive smarter, more reliable decisions in real time.

Book a Demo
Bug Identification
and Logging

Forget the extra manual effort. As CoTester runs, it looks for bugs, flags them, and logs them automatically. Your team gets clear visibility into issues the moment they happen.

Book a Demo
Scheduled Test
Execution

Schedule test runs at the times that work best for you, nightly builds, weekly regressions, or right before a major release using CoTester. Keep your testing aligned with your delivery cadence.

Book a Demo
Adaptive Learning

The more you use CoTester, the smarter it becomes. With each task and every bit of feedback, CoTester learns, adapts, and reduces flakiness in your tests. It evolves into a sharp testing partner!

Book a Demo
Accelerate Testing Without Compromising Control

Spend less time scripting, rewriting, and reacting to brittle tests and more time building software. With CoTester, there’s no need to retrain your team or overhaul your process. Just onboard, show it how your system works, and it gets to work.

But you’re always in control.

Manually edit test steps anytime

Easily switch to scriptless, record-and-play, or code mode for nuanced test case generation.

You stay in the driver’s seat

This AI agent for software testing never runs anything without your approval. Always enjoy full visibility.

Bring your own data

Connect internal databases and securely parameterize test data, with encryption for secrets.

Integrate custom hooks

Insert hooks into pipelines, customize how and when tests run, and align automation to your stack.

Book a Demo
Built for Modern Cloud ERP Ecosystem

CoTester supports full-lifecycle testing for top enterprise Cloud ERP platforms ensuring every workflow runs flawlessly.

Book a Demo
Endorsed by Industry Leaders

CoTester is backed by experts who’ve built, scaled, and led some of the world’s most demanding test environments.

While CoTester adapts like a human, it also executes with robotic precision.

By combining AI-driven adaptability with Robotic Test Automation (RTA), CoTester ensures:

Faster test creation with minimal manual effort

Lower maintenance overhead over time

Creative, intelligent test design that adapts to change

Reliable, rule-based execution for consistent results

How CoTester Works
The AI Agent for Testing, Reimagined

CoTester goes beyond analysis. It understands UI flows, adapts to user stories, and builds self-healing, scalable tests that evolve with your product.

Create

Upload docs, paste a URL, or just describe what needs testing. CoTester figures out the rest.

Refine

Use the chat interface or editor to tweak steps and update workflows manually or with AI help.

Debug

Let the agent find breakpoints, suggest improvements, and adapt test logic to UI changes in real time.

Execute

Run tests on real devices and browsers, validate flows, and get execution logs and screenshots instantly.

Whether you are a QA engineer, a business analyst or a product owner, CoTester gives you the flexibility to generate, manage and execute test cases in the way that works best for you.

FAQs
What is CoTester, and how is it different from traditional testing tools?

CoTester is a purpose-built AI agent for test automation that doesn’t rely on scripts or record-and-play tools. Unlike legacy platforms, it autonomously understands your feature specs, generates test logic, and runs tests which adapt as your UI evolves, while involving a human in the loop process to author test cases.

What industries is CoTester designed for?

CoTester is a domain-aware AI testing agent built for industries where precision and scalability are critical. It’s already being used in sectors like banking and finance (BFSI), eCommerce, telecom, healthcare, and travel. As a specialized software testing AI agent, CoTester understands the unique testing needs of each domain, helping teams accelerate QA without compromising compliance or control.

Who can use CoTester?

Whether you’re a QA engineer, a beginner in automation, a business analyst, or a product owner in a fast-paced agile team, CoTester is your intuitive AI testing agent. It seamlessly adapts to your workflows, empowering everyone to contribute to quality, simplifying test automation without sacrificing control. CoTester is perfect for teams of all skill levels and roles.
